cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. This dripping tap is our chance to replace the whole sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only needs a washer. I've bought one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Excellent. We'll fit it while the sink's out and replace that swollen worktop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The worktop runs under every cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll empty the kitchen. With the cupboards out, we can finally fix the layout.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 professionalism is generic while the expanding removal plan clearly performs D48.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 washer fix leads to A3 sink/worktop replacement; B4 cupboard dependency leads to A5 whole-kitchen layout.

relationship.evidence: B2 supplies a simple fix and B4 explains practical disruption, which A treats as support for larger work.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 reason to stop into a chance to redesign the whole space.

specificity.evidence: A1 dripping tap and B4 continuous worktop establish the escalating repair context.
